title: WARM delta packet, coverage integrity and controlled cost
description: Run with FARMSLOT_WARM_DELTA_PROOF_OUT set to a new evidence directory, FARMSLOT_NATIVE_COMPACTION_PROOF_OUT set to a second new directory and an existing provider credential. A disposable authenticated gateway drives two real terminal reviews over a controlled two-commit delta, preserving the conversation and disabling publication. No shared broker or production run is changed.

coverage-integrity.intent: Compose and accept actual marked coverage; refuse forged rows, changed proof and post-cleanup tampering.

controlled-warm.intent: Create real cold and warm terminal review runs through gateway RPC. Require resumed identity, structured manual compaction, validated row reuse, no provider writes, at most 12 delta calls and under 10000 delta output tokens. Report compaction separately.

native-maintenance.intent: Use the compiled native host IPC client with a subscription login. Require same-session structured maintenance, unchanged task-command count, exact receipt retry and retained finding recall. This proves native SDK maintenance, not native workspace WARM admission.
